meaning: DATA_AMP_POST summarises the recording's post-release ICP pulse amplitude as the median over a window starting 10 s after jugular compression ends and running to the end of the record. The 10 s offset discards the release transient, so the number describes recovered amplitude, not recovery dynamics.

could_move.what: The post-release amplitude target used in the m5 fit and its verification
The constant is also referenced in the m1 data module, so m1 fits and checks see any change too
Reported amplitude comparison against the recording
Model-to-model amplitude comparison scored against the same target

expectation: Unknown in size. Direction depends on how fast amplitude recovers after release: if recovery is slower than 10 s, the window includes still-elevated beats and DATA_AMP_POST sits above the recovered level, so a longer offset would lower it. If no valid beats fall in the window the value is NaN and that propagates into whatever consumes it.

check.why: Re-checks the existing m5 fit against the data-derived amplitude targets without re-fitting, so a shifted or NaN DATA_AMP_POST shows up in the reported residuals.
